known_gaps: No single paper directly decomposes emotion-rating prediction into within-person state and between-person trait components.
Several datasets measure induced emotion in one or a few sessions; stable trait inference is indirect.
FACED and the music dataset use different rating scales and induction paradigms.
No PDF/table/figure verification was possible through the text extraction.
excluded_sources: Subject Identity Confounds qEEG Emotion Recognition on DEAP and DREAMER: landing page only, methods/results body not available.
The emotion-elicited late positive potential is stable across five testing sessions: publisher fetch returned 404; not included.
